Production sprite atlas for original mobile folklore MOBA MONSTER MASH. Exactly 4 columns x 4 rows, sixteen equally sized square cells in a square 2048px image. Consistent beautiful painterly 3D game-render style, chunky readable silhouettes, 3/4 overhead isometric view, midnight blues moss greens and ivory with luminous eyes, high contrast. ROW 3: 9 huge mossy antlered forest boar boss, 10 small glowing amber jack-o-lantern wisp, 11 small floating blue eye spirit, 12 a gnarled stump with green glowing eyes. All sixteen objects individually cuttable, full silhouettes, distinct shapes, no magenta color on objects.

generated.purpose: Town, forest, water and path textures

params.prompt: Game terrain texture atlas for atmospheric illustrated folklore MOBA. Square image divided EXACTLY into four equal square quadrants, no borders, no text. Orthographic straight down ground texture only, seamless repeatable each quadrant, fully filled ground to every edge. Upper left quadrant: weathered midnight-blue and dark grey wet cobblestone pavement with tiny gold flecks, no buildings or large objects. Upper right quadrant: lush mossy forest floor muted jade green and blue, scattered small fern leaves and roots, no trees, no large objects. Lower left quadrant: moonlit dark teal shallow lake water with fine ripples and hints of underwater stones, no shore. Lower right quadrant: old grey dirt and broken stone trail with amber leaves. Premium hand-painted storybook game art, legible quiet textures, eerie luminous midnight palette, subdued balanced contrast, no baked shadows or light spots, consistent medium texture scale.

processing: Cropped cells, chroma-key magenta removal, repacked 16 sprites, transparent WebP and four portraits. Ground atlas converted to WebP. Geometry, fog, UI and effects are native code.
limitations: 2D sprites. No rigged 3D or 404-GEN integration. No 404 connector/credential; fal catalog query returned no 404 endpoint. Higgsfield terrain request rejected before submission for unavailable model, then completed through fal.
